title: 咏田家
author: 聂夷中

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait illustration for a premium Chinese poetry reader. Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 咏田家 — 聂夷中
二月卖新丝，五月粜新谷。
医得眼前疮，剜却心头肉。
我愿君王心，化作光明烛。
不照绮罗筵，只照逃亡屋。
